scriptData.label: @effect.name
Thigh Wound

description.label: Description
description.value:
The bullet bores through your thigh, creating a gory wound canal just laterally of the femur, lodging underneath the skin at the back of your leg.

Effects: Pass an Average (+20) Endurance Test or go @Condition[Prone]. Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (2) and suffer a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.nF5z1OEhpi4t6a6S]{Torn Muscle (Minor)}.

Surgery (Easy) is required for Extraction.
